successors.name: Habesh Eyalet
successors.text: the Dahlak islands, around 643 km2, led by Dahlak Kebir

ledger.x: c. 1050: start date is the task's estimate. The page says only 'Between around 1140 and 1249, the Dahlak Islands were ruled by a line of sultans' and that 'sultan' is first used in 1093.
c. 1557: the islands, destroyed by the Portuguese in 1541, are 'occupied by the Ottoman Empire again' and made part of the Habesh Eyalet.
c. 1557: the Dahlak sultanate ends under Ottoman occupation.

certainty.note: Island group; the page gives no frontier and no area for the sultanate itself.
